title: Functions of government
competency: Describe the four main functions of government.

keywords.def: The operational arm of the state. It makes, enforces and interprets laws.
A service the government provides to people living within its borders.
Protecting the country and its people from outside and inside threats.

en.text: Citizens expect government to do four main things: maintain social stability, provide public services, provide national security and make economic decisions. Maintaining law and order is one of the most important. Government passes laws, provides courts to settle disputes and limits what people may do.

screens.title: No laws?
screens.ask: What would happen in your town if there were no laws and no courts?
opts: Disputes would grow and people would not be safe
screens.after: Laws and courts keep peace and protect people. That is the first function of government.

screens.title: 2.3 Functions of government
paras: Citizens expect their government to perform certain functions.
They vary by state, but these are the most common:

screens.title: i. Maintaining law and order
paras: One of the most important goals of a democratic government is law and order.
Government passes laws for all members of society.
Laws keep the peace and protect rights, property and lives.
Courts help citizens settle disputes in a timely, orderly way.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The operational arm of the state. It makes, enforces and interprets laws.

screens.text: How does a government keep law and order?
opts: By passing laws and providing courts
screens.ans: By passing laws and providing courts
screens.why: Governments pass laws and provide courts to settle disputes.

screens.text: Tap the FOUR common functions of government.
screens.why: These are the four functions the book lists.
screens.clue: Two of these are not government jobs.

screens.text: Government decisions are binding on all citizens of the state.
screens.why: To carry out its functions, government makes decisions binding on all citizens.
screens.clue: Read the text after the list.

screens.text: Abebe's goat is stolen. The police find the thief and a court decides the case. Which function is this?
screens.why: Police and courts protect property and settle disputes: law and order.
screens.clue: Which function uses laws, police and courts?

en.text: Government provides public services such as health, fire protection, housing and transport. It protects citizens with national defense forces against outside and inside threats. It also makes economic decisions: it controls inflation, encourages trade and regulates natural resources, like the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam.

screens.title: Who pays for the clinic?
screens.ask: A health worker checks people's temperature at a health centre. Who usually provides this?
opts: The government, as a public service
screens.after: Health services are public services. Government provides them for everyone.

screens.title: ii. Providing public services
paras: Government provides essential public services for community life and well-being.
It gives them directly or by funding private providers.
Public services are so important that everyone should get them.
Examples: fire protection, law enforcement, environmental protection, public housing and public transport.

screens.title: iii. Providing national security
paras: Government provides common defense and security for its citizens.
It guards against external and internal threats.
It keeps national defense forces: troops, arms and peacekeeping missions.
It also keeps good relations with foreign countries.

screens.title: iv. Making economic decisions
paras: No country can meet all its citizens' needs.
Government promotes growth: it controls inflation, encourages trade and regulates natural resources.
It makes rules that shape the economy.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A service the government provides to people living within its borders.
Protecting the country and its people from outside and inside threats.

screens.text: Which of these is a public service?
screens.why: The book lists public transportation as a public service.
screens.clue: Which one does government provide for everyone?

screens.title: Which function?
screens.why: Each example belongs to one function of government.
screens.clue: Ask: is it a service, defense, or money and trade?

screens.text: If Ethiopia is invaded, who defends the country?
opts: The national defense force, set up by the government
screens.ans: The national defense force, set up by the government
screens.why: The government creates and keeps national defense forces.

screens.text: The government builds the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam to produce electricity. Which TWO functions does this serve most?
opts: National security and law and order
screens.why: It develops a natural resource (economy) and gives electricity to people (a service).
screens.clue: Think: money and resources, and services for everyone.

items.text: What is the purpose of government?
opts: To carry out state authority and keep peace and order
To make a few people rich
items.ans: To carry out state authority and keep peace and order
items.why: Government carries out state authority and makes, enforces and interprets laws.
items.clue: Recall what government does with laws.

items.text: What are the primary responsibilities of government? Tap all.
items.clue: One option is not a government job.

items.text: What role can a democratic government play in social stability?
opts: Pass laws, provide courts and set limits on behaviour
items.ans: Pass laws, provide courts and set limits on behaviour
items.why: This is how government keeps law and order.

items.text: If Ethiopia is invaded by another country, who will defend it?
opts: The government's national defense force, with citizens
items.ans: The government's national defense force, with citizens
items.why: Government keeps national defense forces to defend the country.

test.text: Which is one of the most important functions of a democratic government?
test.why: The book says this is one of the most important functions.

test.text: Public transport is an example of a public service.
test.why: The book lists public transportation as a public service.

test.text: Controlling inflation is part of which function?
Government guards only against external threats.
test.why: It guards against both external and internal threats.

test.text: A town gets clean water pipes from the government. A court also settles a land case there. Which functions are shown?
opts: Public services and law and order
test.ans: Public services and law and order
test.why: Water is a public service; the court keeps law and order.
